The road to Amber (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Chronicles_of_Amber) begins in Arden.
The Amber chronicle (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Chronicles_of_Amber) rests on the shelf.
Amber welcomes a traveler: café, лес, 海, 🌙.

Amber faces the sea. The paths through Arden lead toward its harbor. Corwin knows every road (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Chronicles_of_Amber) that ends at the quay, and he walks the last mile slowly, counting lanterns as they wake along the wall.

The city rises in terraces above the water. Pale towers catch the first light while the lower streets still hold the night. Bakers open their doors before the bells, and the smell of warm bread drifts down the stairs toward the fish market, where the boats are already…
